summary: Verified review of commit 9488c86 ('feat: add scoped show workspaces and operator workflows'; 138 files, +28,043/-826, 117 under src/). Verifier opened every cited file/line range. Of 28 findings: 9 confirmed, 19 adjusted, 0 refuted. Of 16 proposed splits: 3 confirmed, 13 adjusted (one sub-move, RuleConfig to domain/graph_rules.rs, refuted inside the storage/registry.rs split). Main corrections: (1) the store file is show-workspaces.json, not shows.json; (2) any new pure persistence core placed in src/controller/ must not reference crate::ui (architecture_tests background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui), so FailureEvidence/run_serialized stay in a ui-side coordinator; (3) any move into src/domain/ or src/services/ must not name storage types (domain_and_services_do_not_reach_into_storage) - this refutes moving RuleConfig into domain/graph_rules.rs and moving impl SceneRegistry into domain before the type itself becomes domain; (4) domain/bookmark.rs, domain/obs.rs and domain/registry.rs::SceneRegistrySnapshot already exist and should be extended; (5) controller/state/mixer.rs (1396 lines) already exists, so the proposed state/audio.rs must be planned together with it; (6) the close-retry gap (finding 02) is broader: session-report export, config-snapshot and worker-panic failures are also never re-admitted; (7) hotkey gating on curation readiness and retry-on-unchanged-edit are documented intentional behaviour (docs/feature-program.md:166-167, docs/configuration.md:215-216), so changes there need doc updates; (8) complete_workspace mutates AppState beyond WorkspaceState, so it moves as impl AppState. Recommended order unchanged: fix 01 (cards/dispatch only), fix 02, extract persistence core + ui coordinator, domain aggregates behind storage mappers, AppState sub-aggregates, operator policy to services (domain-typed views), split window.rs apply_event, regroup ui/. Not verified: runtime behaviour (no tests run), ui/global_shortcuts/portal.rs, ui/preflight/*, exact line numbers inside live.rs/report_history.rs split targets beyond function starts.

findings.title: Program-scene switching is disabled whenever optional curation registry is not Ready
findings.evidence: NavigationContext::dispatch returns silently for AppCommand::SwitchPrimaryScene when `!self.registry_is_current() || registry_import_busy()`. registry_is_current requires show_registry.status == RegistryStatus::Ready (navigation.rs:112-122). live.rs:673-677 renders no scene cards when registry_availability_message is Some (Loading/Unavailable/Failed); hotkeys.rs:160 refuses slot activation unless Ready. RegistryStatus::Failed is set by finish_registry_load on any shows.json read error (show_registry.rs:134), e.g. corrupt file, version!=1, or store larger than REGISTRY_LIMIT. registry_import_busy is also checked twice (inside registry_is_current and again at line 185).
findings.risk: A corrupt or oversized local metadata file removes the operator's primary live control (switching program/preview from SceneDeck) for the whole session. The same happens briefly after every connect/collection change while the workspace loads. The OBS command does not depend on curation data.
findings.recommendation: Separate the two concerns. (1) Scene switching is an OBS control capability: gate it only on workspace.scene_action(scene).is_some() and session currency. (2) Curation gating (order, roles, slots) degrades gracefully: when the registry is not Ready, render cards in OBS inventory order with no roles and keep hotkeys working off inventory order (or turn hotkeys off with a visible notice, but never the cards). Implement as `ScenePresentationPolicy` in src/services/scene_presentation.rs taking (SceneInventory, Option<&ShowWorkspace>). Drop the duplicate registry_import_busy() check. Add a unit test: RegistryStatus::Failed + connected session -> scene_action dispatch is admitted.
findings.verifier_note: Code confirmed: dispatch() returns early for SwitchPrimaryScene unless registry_is_current() (requires RegistryStatus::Ready, navigation.rs:111-122); live.rs:673-677 builds no scene slots when registry_availability_message() is Some; scene_card.rs:107-109 sets cards insensitive unless registry_is_current(); registry_import_busy() is checked twice (navigation.rs:114 and 185). Adjustments: (a) the store file is show-workspaces.json, not shows.json; (b) 'for the whole session' is overstated - docs/configuration.md:205-207 documents an Inventory Retry for corrupt data, though a persistently corrupt/oversized file does keep switching disabled; (c) hotkey gating is documented as intentional (docs/feature-program.md:166-167 'scene hotkeys cannot use stale curation while a selection loads') because slot->scene mapping depends on curation order - keep hotkeys gated, fix only cards + dispatch. Recommendation: gate SwitchPrimaryScene in NavigationContext::dispatch only on is_current() + workspace.scene_action(scene); render cards in OBS inventory order (no roles/accents) when status != Ready, with the availability banner shown above them. A services/scene_presentation.rs policy must take domain inputs only (SceneInventory + Option<&domain::registry::SceneRegistrySnapshot>, which already exists in src/domain/registry.rs:114), not a storage type (architecture_tests domain_and_services_do_not_reach_into_storage). Test: AppState with RegistryStatus::Failed + Connected -> a pure helper (e.g. AppState::scene_switch_admitted) returns true.

findings.title: Close-failure Retry re-admits only registry and history writes; bookmark, session-report export, config-snapshot and worker-panic failures keep the close barrier failing
findings.evidence: The Retry response calls ui::persist::retry_registry_writes() and ui::report_history::retry_active() only. Bookmark save failures are pushed to bookmarks.rs FAILURES and background_io::record_failure() (bookmarks.rs:64-73) and are resolved only by a later successful bookmark save (bookmarks.rs:47-56), which needs the Bookmarks window's retry button. background_io::flush_pending returns Err(WorkerFailed) while UNRESOLVED_FAILURES is non-empty (background_io.rs:325-332). So after a bookmark write failure, Close -> Retry -> drain fails again, and the user can only Abandon. Verdict: plausible, reasoned from code, not reproduced. Every new persisted store must also be hand-added to this hard-coded list in app.rs.
findings.risk: The user is stuck in a retry loop at exit, or abandons bookmarks unaware; the app looks unable to close cleanly.
findings.recommendation: Introduce `trait DurableStore { fn retry(&self); fn status(&self) -> SaveStatus; }` in src/controller/persistence/mod.rs (or src/application/persistence/). Register registry, report-history, settings and bookmarks stores in a `PersistenceCoordinator` owned by the shell. CloseGuard calls coordinator.retry_all(), not named functions. Add a native or pure test: bookmark write fails, close, retry succeeds after fixing the path, window closes without abandon.
findings.original_title: Close-failure Retry re-admits registry and history writes but not failed bookmark writes (Shotgun Surgery on new stores)
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed and broader than stated. app.rs:413-416 Retry calls only ui::persist::retry_registry_writes() and ui::report_history::retry_active(). flush_pending (background_io.rs:318-345) returns WorkerFailed while UNRESOLVED_FAILURES is non-empty. Other producers of background_io::record_failure() that Retry never re-admits: ui/bookmarks.rs:72, ui/session_reports.rs:459 (EXPORT_FAILURES, resolved only by re-exporting the same report to the same path), background_io.rs:226 (config snapshot batch failed), background_io.rs:370 (worker panicked). Still unreproduced (plausible). Layering fix to the recommendation: a DurableStore trait may live in controller only if GTK-free and it must not mention ui::background_io::FailureEvidence (architecture_tests background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui forbids crate::ui in controller/storage/obs). Put the PersistenceCoordinator that drives background_io and owns retry_all() in src/ui/persistence/coordinator.rs; CloseGuard calls coordinator.retry_all(). Also decide explicitly whether export failures (user-initiated, not durable state) should block close at all - likely they should be acknowledged, not retried.

findings.title: Three hand-rolled thread_local durable-snapshot state machines live in ui/ (duplicated knowledge, hidden singletons)
findings.evidence: persist.rs: thread_local REGISTRY_WRITES (revision, BTreeMap<u64,RegistryOperation>, failures, error, retrying), REGISTRY_IMPORTING, AFTER_REGISTRY_IMPORT. report_history.rs: thread_local ACTIVE (Weak<RefCell<AppState>> service locator), FAILURES, SETTINGS_FAILURES, plus save/reload/save_settings. bookmarks.rs: thread_local FAILURES plus save() with pending/saved_revision/failed_revision. All three implement the same concept: revisioned snapshot, serialized lane write, success confirms through revision, failure records FailureEvidence, explicit retry resolves it. app.rs reaches them through free functions (ui::report_history::finish_for_shutdown/abandon_exit/checkpoint_before_close/retry_active).
findings.risk: Behaviour can only be tested inside GTK-isolated child processes (isolated_test_child or native_test). Fixes must be made three times. Globals make ownership implicit (ACTIVE silently retargets on register), and there is no compile-time link between AppState and its writers.
findings.recommendation: Extract one GTK-free generic `DurableSnapshot<T: Clone + PartialEq>` with enum `SaveState { Idle, Saving { revision, force_after: bool }, Failed { revision, error, evidence } }` in src/controller/persistence/snapshot.rs, with pure methods begin_save() -> Option<(T, u64)>, finish(revision, Result) and retry(). Keep a thin GTK adapter in src/ui/persistence_bridge.rs that drives background_io::run_serialized. Move RegistryWrites (write-ahead replay queue) to src/controller/persistence/registry_queue.rs as an owned struct held by a `PersistenceCoordinator` that NavigationContext carries as Rc instead of thread_local. Port the existing isolated persist.rs tests to plain unit tests on the pure core.
findings.smell: Duplicate Code (knowledge) / Global Data / Divergent Change
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: thread_locals at persist.rs:42-43 and 207-209, report_history.rs:21-24, bookmarks.rs:21-22; there is also a fourth failure registry at session_reports.rs:22-23. Adjustment: the pure core cannot reference crate::ui::background_io::FailureEvidence or call run_serialized if it lives in src/controller/ (architecture_tests background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui). Make DurableSnapshot<T, E> generic over the evidence token (or keep evidence in the ui adapter), and keep RegistryWrites' replay closures (Arc<dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>>) - these are fine in controller since they are Send+Sync and GTK-free. The coordinator that owns the thread_local replacement and drives background_io must stay in ui (src/ui/persistence/). Holding it in NavigationContext conflicts with finding 13's goal of a narrow NavigationContext - prefer passing Rc<PersistenceCoordinator> to page builders that need it, or accept NavigationContext as an app-context and update CLAUDE.md.

findings.lines: 19-30, 438-499 (AppState), plus impl blocks in state/report_history.rs:52, state/session_reports.rs:63, state/bookmarks.rs:73, state/show_registry.rs:39, state/audio_presets.rs:4
findings.title: AppState grew 9 fields; feature behaviour was relocated into 6 new `impl AppState` files, not decomposed
findings.evidence: New fields: preset_run, preset_serial, report_history, reports, bookmarks, health, connected_connection_id, show_registry, obs_stats_observed_at. AppState now has about 50 fields. Feature methods (prepare_report_exit, collect_report, capture_bookmark, select_registry, load_report_history...) are all `impl AppState` in sibling files, so each one reads and writes across sub-states (e.g. collect_report reads workspace.activity, workspace.output_results, scene_collections, scene_inventory, obs_stats*, health, bookmarks and writes reports). 111 pub fns sit across state.rs and state/*.rs. The splitting reduces file length but not the concepts a reader must hold.
findings.risk: Every feature can mutate every field. Invariants such as 'reports.revision bump implies stage_report_history' live only in the call order inside many methods. RefCell borrow_mut contention grows as one borrow covers everything.
findings.recommendation: Turn sub-states into aggregates that own their methods and take explicit inputs: `SessionReports::collect(&mut self, ctx: &ReportContext)`, where ReportContext is a read-only view struct built by AppState holding activity, outputs, scene, stats sample, alerts and bookmark session. Same pattern for `BookmarkLog::capture(&mut self, BookmarkContext)` and `ShowWorkspaceSelection::select(...)`. AppState keeps only orchestration methods (apply_connected etc.) that build contexts and call aggregates. Target layout: src/controller/state/{mod.rs (AppState shell), session.rs (connection/ObsStatus/available_requests/endpoint/id), outputs.rs (OutputTrack x2), topology.rs, audio.rs, stats.rs, reports/, bookmarks/, show_registry/}.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: AppState (state.rs:437-499) has ~45 pub fields; impl AppState blocks exist in state/report_history.rs, session_reports.rs, bookmarks.rs, show_registry.rs, audio_presets.rs, mixer.rs. Field count '~50' is approximate (45 counted lines with pub in the struct). Adjustment to target layout: src/controller/state/mixer.rs (1396 lines) already exists and owns mixer/audio state; the proposed state/audio.rs must be planned together with it (split mixer.rs into audio/levels.rs, audio/mixer_selection.rs etc.) rather than add a parallel audio module. state.rs is a file-module with a state/ dir (Rust 2018 style); keep state.rs as the shell rather than creating state/mod.rs, to avoid a needless rename.

findings.title: Storage serde DTOs are used as live controller aggregates; storage path types leak into controller (no anti-corruption layer)
findings.evidence: ReportHistoryState.archive/stored are storage::report_history::HistoryArchive, and domain rules (upsert, retain) are implemented on the storage type (storage/report_history.rs:86-109). BookmarksState.archive is storage::bookmarks::BookmarkArchive, and controller code mutates archive.entries/next_id/next_session directly (bookmarks.rs:41-69, 120-164). ShowRegistryState.target is storage::show_workspaces::RegistryTarget, which embeds PathBuf and is built via xdg paths inside AppState::desired_registry_target (show_registry.rs:63-70). NavigationContext also stores RegistryTarget (navigation.rs:31). CLAUDE.md says storage structs must convert to domain snapshots before services use them.
findings.risk: File format changes ripple into controller and ui. Domain invariants such as the bookmark limit, id monotonicity and retention live in storage validation and controller code at once. Tests need filesystem paths to express domain identity.
findings.recommendation: Create domain aggregates: src/domain/session_history.rs (`SessionHistory { entries, upsert, retain }`), src/domain/bookmark.rs (`BookmarkLog { next_id, next_session, entries; capture(), rename(), remove() }`), src/domain/show_workspace.rs (`WorkspaceKey`, `ShowWorkspaceId`). Storage keeps `HistoryArchiveDto`/`BookmarkArchiveDto` with From/TryFrom mappers in the same storage files. Replace RegistryTarget in controller and ui with a pure `CurationScope { Legacy, Workspace(WorkspaceKey) }`. storage::show_workspaces resolves CurationScope -> path inside the worker closure. Extend architecture_tests.rs to forbid `crate::storage::` imports in src/controller/state/** except mapper call sites.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: ReportHistoryState.archive/stored are storage::report_history::HistoryArchive (report_history.rs:4,9-10); upsert/retain on the storage type (storage/report_history.rs:86-109); BookmarksState.archive is storage::bookmarks::BookmarkArchive and next_session is mutated in controller (bookmarks.rs:8,13,36-46); ShowRegistryState.target is RegistryTarget (show_registry.rs:5-8,19-25); NavigationContext stores RegistryTarget (navigation.rs:31). Adjustments: (a) CLAUDE.md wording is 'convert to domain snapshots before services use them' - the controller (not services) using storage types is a softer deviation, but still the missing ACL; (b) src/domain/bookmark.rs already exists (Bookmark, BOOKMARK_LIMIT, valid_name) - extend it with BookmarkLog rather than create it; (c) controller/state.rs itself imports storage::config::AppConfig and storage::registry::SceneRegistry, so a new architecture test forbidding crate::storage in controller/state/** can only land as the final step after AppConfig and SceneRegistry also get domain counterparts; scope the first version of the rule to state/report_history.rs, state/bookmarks.rs and state/show_registry.rs.

findings.title: SceneRegistry became a god aggregate spanning five bounded contexts in one serde struct and one file
findings.evidence: The commit adds scene_uuids, retained_scenes, scene_filter, decks, action_bindings (domain::action_shortcut), quick_actions (domain::operator_action), audio_alerts (domain::health::AudioRule) and audio_presets (domain::audio_preset) to SceneRegistry. It is persisted whole per workspace in shows.json. The storage struct imports four domain contexts. Every mutation (a deck query, a shortcut, a preset) clones and rewrites the whole thing (persist.rs:517-536).
findings.risk: Divergent Change: scene curation, operator shortcuts, health rules and audio presets all edit one type and one file. Schema evolution of any one risks the others. The 'registry' name no longer matches the ubiquitous language (show workspace).
findings.recommendation: Introduce domain aggregate `ShowWorkspace { curation: SceneCuration, views: DeckViews, operator: OperatorSetup { bindings, quick_actions }, audio: AudioSetup { alerts, presets } }` in src/domain/show_workspace/{mod,curation,views,operator,audio}.rs. Keep `SceneRegistryDto` in storage/registry/ as the serde form with field-for-field From impls, so the on-disk format is unchanged. Split storage/registry.rs into storage/registry/{dto.rs, io.rs (read/write/yaml), rules.rs (RuleConfig/policy), accent.rs (scene_accent_hex/parse_scene_accent)}.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: SceneRegistry (registry.rs:23-72) carries decks, action_bindings, quick_actions, audio_alerts, audio_presets alongside curation; whole-snapshot write per edit via persist_registry (persist.rs:511-536). File name: show-workspaces.json, not shows.json. Adjustments: storage/registry/ already has decks.rs and identity.rs submodules - the dto/io/rules/accent split must sit next to them. src/domain/registry.rs already has SceneRegistrySnapshot (line 114) and SceneMetadata - grow the domain ShowWorkspace from that existing snapshot instead of a fresh type. Moving `impl SceneRegistry` blocks into src/domain/show_workspace/curation.rs is only legal after the type itself becomes a domain type; while SceneRegistry is a storage type, domain cannot name it (architecture_tests domain_and_services_do_not_reach_into_storage).

findings.title: Every scene-search change rewrites the entire show-workspaces.json store (all workspaces)
findings.evidence: search.connect_search_changed -> apply_inputs -> apply -> persist_registry('scene view') sets registry.scene_filter and submits target.write(&registry). For RegistryTarget::Workspace, write() does read_store (read plus parse plus validate up to 8 MiB), replaces one entry, serializes all entries pretty-printed, and does an atomic write (show_workspaces.rs:50-66, 152-157). Each submission also clones the full SceneRegistry into an Arc closure retained in REGISTRY_WRITES until confirmed (persist.rs:133-146).
findings.risk: Disk churn and fsync per search pause. Cost grows with the number of workspaces. A failure on transient view state forces the close barrier dialog.
findings.recommendation: Treat the live search query as session view state (keep it in AppState, not persisted), or debounce persistence (for example 1 s after the last change) through one coalescible snapshot like background_io::run_config_snapshot. Persist only named decks. Longer term, write workspaces as separate files (shows/<hash>.json) so one write touches one workspace.
findings.original_title: Every scene-search change rewrites the entire shows.json store (all workspaces)
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: search.connect_search_changed (deck_controls.rs:283-286) -> apply (52-62) -> persist_registry('scene view') -> RegistryTarget::Workspace write = read_store + replace + to_vec_pretty + atomic write (show_workspaces.rs:50-66, 152-157). GtkSearchEntry's search-changed already has a short built-in delay, so 'per search pause' is accurate. Adjustment: persisting scene_filter is intentional (registry.rs:36-38 'Current view shared by Inventory and Live in this workspace'), so do not drop persistence without a product decision; prefer debounce/coalesce (one pending snapshot per target, write latest after ~1 s idle) and mark view-state write failures as non-blocking for close. Also note persist_registry's unchanged branch calls retry_registry_writes() (persist.rs:521-524), so every no-op filter event also triggers retry of failed writes.

findings.title: All workspaces share one file and one 8 MiB REGISTRY_LIMIT with no eviction or garbage collection
findings.evidence: load_or_create appends a StoredWorkspace for every new (connection, endpoint, collection) key. Nothing removes entries (no deletion path in storage/config/connections.rs or ui/pages/settings/connections.rs). read_store/write_store enforce REGISTRY_LIMIT on the whole store. docs/configuration.md:199 says changing an endpoint selects separate curation, so DHCP or host edits mint new entries. Once the combined size passes the limit, every read fails -> RegistryStatus::Failed for all workspaces (and, through finding 01, scene switching is lost). Verdict: plausible; size growth not measured.
findings.risk: Silent long-term degradation. One user's history of endpoints and collections bricks curation for all shows.
findings.recommendation: Store one file per workspace (src/storage/show_workspaces/ with an index), or add LRU or explicit 'forget workspace' management with a cap on entries. At minimum, surface the store size and the oldest workspaces in Settings and let the user prune. Add a test that a store near the limit still loads.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed structurally: load_or_create appends entries (show_workspaces.rs:71-93), no removal path exists in show_workspaces.rs (grep: no retain/remove), REGISTRY_LIMIT = 8 MiB on the whole store (small_file.rs:10, show_workspaces.rs:121-157), docs/configuration.md:199-200 confirms endpoint change selects separate curation. Severity lowered to low: 8 MiB of JSON metadata needs thousands of workspaces in practice; unmeasured. Keep the 'forget workspace' / size surfacing recommendation; one-file-per-workspace is optional.

findings.title: Localized UI text and ad-hoc strings are persisted as report domain data (stringly-typed events)
findings.evidence: apply_connected ends the previous report with `finish_report(&ObsStatus::Connecting.label())`, a translated label (state.rs:755). ui/report_history.rs passes fl!("history-exit-requested"/"history-exit-resumed"/"history-app-closed") as reasons. collect_report maps AlertKind to literal strings ("connection_lost", "audio_silence", ...) and AlertPhase to "active"/"recovering"/"unobserved" into ReportEvent::Health { kind: String, phase: Option<String> }. report_export and the ui session_reports page parse or print them again.
findings.risk: Persisted history changes language with locale. Exports mix languages. Renaming an enum variant cannot be caught by the compiler. Health keys include the input display name (session_reports.rs:347-350), so an input rename emits spurious cleared/active pairs (plausible).
findings.recommendation: Add `enum ReportEndReason { Reconnected, AppClosed, ExitRequested, Disconnected }` and `enum ReportActivity::ExitResumed` to src/domain/session_report.rs. Make ReportEvent::Health carry `kind: AlertKind` and `phase: Option<AlertPhase>` with #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")], so the existing JSON stays compatible. Localize only in ui/session_reports.rs::event_text. Key health by input UUID when known.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: state.rs:755 finish_report(&ObsStatus::Connecting.label()) and label() is fl!-localized (state.rs:105-114); ui/report_history.rs:105 passes fl!(history-app-closed); session_reports.rs:336-388 maps AlertKind/AlertPhase to literal strings; ReportEvent::Health { kind: String, input, phase: Option<String> } and Ended { reason: String } (domain/session_report.rs:38-58). Adjustment: existing persisted histories already contain localized reason strings, so a typed ReportEndReason needs a backward-compatible deserializer (e.g. an `Other(String)` fallback / #[serde(untagged)] legacy arm) - snake_case rename alone keeps Health compatible but not Ended. Add golden JSON tests for both before the change.

findings.title: Operator-action policy (identity resolution, capability checks against OBS request names) lives in ui and switches on OperatorAction in four places
findings.evidence: resolve_with_inputs (about 130 lines) decides availability using string literals "SetCurrentPreviewScene", "SetCurrentProgramScene", "SaveReplayBuffer", "SetInputMute", "SetSourceFilterEnabled", "TriggerMediaInputAction" against state.available_requests. These are OBS protocol names outside obs/. observed_label, resolve_with_inputs, binding_entry and execute each destructure the same `OperatorAction::OpenSource{target} | SetMuted{target,..} | ...` arm list. execute uses let-else nested inside let-else with unreachable!() (637-641). binding_entry's `name` closure takes a bool flag (scene: bool). binding_entries calls entries() and then binding_entry() -> resolve() -> inputs(state) clone per entry.
findings.risk: Adding an OperatorAction variant needs edits in 4+ match sites (Shotgun Surgery). Protocol renames leak into UI. The pure decision logic is only testable with an AppState fixture through ui.
findings.recommendation: Move to src/services/operator_actions/{resolve.rs (resolve(&OperatorView, &OperatorAction) -> Option<ResolvedAction>), observe.rs (observed state enum, not localized String), catalog.rs (entries as data)}. Add `OperatorAction::target(&self) -> Option<&ActionTarget>` and `OperatorAction::required_capability()` in src/domain/operator_action.rs. Add `domain::capability::{ObsCapability enum, Capabilities}`, built in obs/mapper.rs from available_requests. Keep ui/action_catalog.rs as label and i18n rendering only (under about 250 lines). Rewrite execute as one `match action { Page, Bookmarks, Reports, Operator }`.
findings.smell: Switch Statements / Shotgun Surgery / Flag Argument
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: request-name literals at action_catalog.rs:194-195, 204, 234, 241, 247, 261, 270; repeated OperatorAction target arm lists in observed_label (99-104) and execute (643-650); execute's nested let-else with unreachable!() (637-642). Adjustment: services must stay pure over domain types - an OperatorView passed to services/operator_actions must be built from domain types (scene inventory, input catalog, studio snapshot, Capabilities) by the caller, not wrap controller::state::AppState, otherwise services would depend on controller. Note ui/widgets/transport_bar.rs also checks available_requests, so the Capabilities type should replace both. Domain ControlAction already lives in domain/control.rs:222, so ResolvedAction can reuse it.

findings.title: apply_event is a ~590-line switch; the commit added inline domain transitions to it
findings.evidence: New arms: OutputReadbackFailed (934-976) mutates last_stream/record_command_error, health, status and activity log directly with duplicated Stream/Record branches. SceneRenamed (1013-1058) runs registry rename, generation bump, conflict reporting and rebuilds. SceneInventoryUpdated (985-1011) branches on registry_import_busy. SceneCollectionsUpdated (1067-1094) does registry scope selection. PresetProgress, PresetRejected and WorkspaceAudioFailed were also added. window.rs production code is 1582 lines; the file total is 2698.
findings.risk: Each new event grows one function. Domain decisions hide in GTK code. Re-entrant apply_event recursion (SessionEvent/Observation/CommandFailed) makes borrow scopes fragile.
findings.recommendation: Split into src/ui/shell/events/{mod.rs (dispatch match only, one line per arm), session.rs, outputs.rs, scenes.rs (inventory/rename/collections + registry scope), audio.rs, workspace.rs, stats.rs}. Move state transitions into AppState or aggregate methods, e.g. `AppState::apply_output_readback_failure(kind, message, observed_at) -> ReadbackOutcome { changed }`, so ui does only toast and refresh. Return an `EffectSet` (rebuild scenes/audio, refresh pages, toast) from reducers for testability.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: apply_event spans window.rs:664-1253; OutputReadbackFailed arm at 934-976 does the duplicated stream/record mutation; SceneRenamed bumps show_registry.generation at 1027-1029. Production/test boundary at 1583 matches. Recommended split is compatible with architecture tests (all modules remain under ui/).

findings.title: GTK-free AppState reducer lives in ui/ (misplaced module)
findings.evidence: The module doc says 'without widget ownership'. Imports are controller::state, controller::workspace, domain and i18n only; no gtk4/adw. Functions acknowledge, media_loaded, complete_workspace (lines 56-179), audio_failed and replay_saved mutate state.workspace.* fields directly. WorkspaceCompletion carries three bools (acknowledged, uncertain, action).
findings.risk: Controller-layer invariants for workspace sit in the UI layer, so other callers (controller tests) must reach into ui. Flag-heavy structs hide distinct outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Move to src/controller/state/workspace_reconciliation.rs as `impl WorkspaceState` methods. Replace the bools with `enum CompletionKind { Refresh, Action { acknowledged: bool }, Uncertain }`. Keep localized result strings out of state (store an enum and localize in ui).
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed GTK-free (imports at event_reconciliation.rs:3-8) and misplaced. Adjustment: complete_workspace touches more than WorkspaceState - it calls state.accept_output_observation, set_stream_status/set_record_status, stream_/record_active_since, health, merge_workspace_audio and workflow_scope - so it cannot be `impl WorkspaceState`; move it as `impl AppState` in src/controller/state/workspace_reconciliation.rs (acknowledge/media_loaded/audio_failed can be WorkspaceState methods). findings.title: NavigationContext widened into a service locator, contradicting the documented page contract

findings.title: show_registry invariants (generation and revision bumps) are mutated directly from ui; registry snapshot lives apart from its target

findings.recommendation: Move `registry` into ShowRegistryState (rename to ShowWorkspaceSelection). Expose `fn edit(&mut self, f) -> Option<EditTicket>` and `fn apply_reconciliation(&inventory) -> Option<Snapshot>` that bump revision and generation internally, and make the fields private. Remove the implicit retry from the unchanged branch; keep retry explicit (Settings or the close dialog).
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: generation bumps at persist.rs:368 and window.rs:1027-1029; revision bumps at persist.rs:526 and 569; retry_registry_writes() on unchanged edits at 523 and 574. Adjustment: retry-on-unchanged-edit is documented behaviour (docs/configuration.md:215-216 'Repeating an unchanged dirty edit also retries retained intent'), so removing it is a behaviour change requiring a docs update; minimally make it explicit (an EditOutcome::Unchanged -> coordinator.retry_failed() at call sites) rather than hidden inside persist_registry. Note interplay with finding 07 (every no-op search event triggers retry).

findings.title: Boolean-flag state machines and tuple or sentinel state instead of enums
findings.evidence: ReportHistoryState has 17 pub fields including 7 independent bools/options (busy, force_after_pending, urgent, clear_pending, settings_pending, exit_abandoned, load_error/save_error/settings_error). CloseGuard has 4 Cells (allowed, pending, abandon, main). BookmarksState.session is Option<(u64, u64, Instant)>, with session_id 0 as the 'archive failed' sentinel checked in capture_bookmark (bookmarks.rs:106). It also has pending: usize, saved_revision and failed_revision.
findings.risk: Illegal combinations are representable (busy && exit_abandoned && clear_pending). Readers must reconstruct the state machine from scattered checks (ui/report_history.rs:117-184).
findings.recommendation: ReportHistory: `enum DiskState { Loading, LoadFailed(String), Idle, Saving{revision, then: FollowUp}, SaveFailed{revision, error} }` plus separate `RetentionPolicy` and `Ownership { eligible, owned }`. CloseGuard: `enum CloseState { Open, Draining, Failed, Allowed }`. Bookmarks: `struct BookmarkSession { number: Option<SessionNumber>, started_unix_ms: u64, started_at: Instant }`. Make fields private with intent-named methods.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed in substance. Corrections: ReportHistoryState has 16 pub fields + 1 private (report_history.rs:8-26), not 17 pub; CloseGuard (app.rs:166-175) has 3 Cells (allowed, pending, abandon) + Rc<Cell> quitting + bool main + RefCell exit - `main` is a plain bool, not a Cell. Sentinel session_id == 0 confirmed at bookmarks.rs:106 (set by begin_session at 37). Recommendation stands.

findings.title: collect_report is a 140-line multi-concern method with repeated unwraps; report id built ad hoc
findings.evidence: collect_report handles collection name, activity gaps, activity copy, output results diff, scene change, stats sampling, health alert diffing (with string mapping) and bookmark id sync, and calls reports.current().unwrap() four times (276, 280, 326, 392) after one guard at 273. begin_report builds the id by SessionReport::new format!("{started}-{session}") + "-{next_run}" + "-{pid}-{nonce}", then a `while archive contains id { push('x') }` loop that checks the archive but not in-memory entries. It also clears five ReportsState fields by hand.
findings.risk: A refactor that moves the guard gives a panic on the GTK thread. The id policy is spread across domain and controller, and collision handling is half-implemented.
findings.recommendation: Split into ReportsState methods with a `ReportContext` input: collect_activity, collect_outputs, collect_scene, collect_sample, collect_health, sync_bookmarks. Bind `let Some(report) = ...` once and pass &mut SessionReport down. Add `ReportId::new(started, session, run, pid, nonce)` in src/domain/session_report.rs with uniqueness checked by `SessionHistory::contains`. Use `ReportsState::reset_for_new_run()` for the five clears.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: four reports.current().unwrap() at session_reports.rs:276, 280, 326, 392 after guard at 273; begin_report has two more back_mut().unwrap() at 158 and 161; id built with next_run + pid + nanos nonce and 'x' suffix loop over archive only (163-178); five manual clears (195-199). Adjustment: in-memory collision is practically impossible (next_run is monotonic in-process), so 'collision handling half-implemented' is overstated; the real smell is that id policy is spread across domain (SessionReport::new) and controller. Recommendation stands.

findings.title: Wall-clock reads inside state transitions; inconsistent with the injected `now` used elsewhere
findings.evidence: prepare_report_exit, resume_report_exit and finish_report call crate::controller::workspace::unix_ms() and Instant::now() internally. collect_report and capture_bookmark take now/unix_ms parameters. load_bookmarks and apply_connected also read the clock. begin_report uses SystemTime nanos for the nonce.
findings.risk: Non-deterministic tests (several tests compensate with sleeps or pump_until). Ordering bugs around exit and resume cannot be reproduced exactly.
findings.recommendation: Introduce `Clock` (`struct Now { instant: Instant, unix_ms: u64 }`) passed into every AppState transition. Callers in ui/window.rs and app.rs create it once per event. Remove direct unix_ms() calls from controller/state/** and enforce this with an architecture test grep.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: prepare_report_exit (session_reports.rs:64-66), resume path (~120) and finish_report (213-215) call unix_ms()/Instant::now(); nonce from SystemTime at 162-165. ui/event_reconciliation.rs:27 also calls unix_ms() inside a reducer. findings.title: Exit-checkpoint protocol is only covered by #[ignore] native GTK tests; no pure decision tests

findings.title: Persistent portal shortcut IDs are derived from serde_json serialization of OperatorAction
findings.evidence: specs() serializes binding.action with serde_json, blanks target.name when a uuid exists, serializes the tuple (connection id, workflow_scope(), identity) and hashes it with SHA-256. There are three `.expect(...)` calls in production (68, 77, 79). Any serde attribute change, field rename or ScopeBinding field addition changes every ID, and desktop-portal bindings the user configured are orphaned.
findings.risk: Silent loss of user-configured global shortcuts after an unrelated refactor.
findings.recommendation: Add `OperatorAction::stable_key(&self) -> String` (explicit, versioned, e.g. "v1:mute:<uuid|name>") in src/domain/operator_action.rs and `WorkspaceKey::stable_key()`. Hash those instead. Add a golden test fixing the ID for a few actions.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed: global_shortcuts.rs:62-90 serializes OperatorAction with serde_json, blanks target.name, hashes (connection id, workflow_scope(), identity); three expects at 68, 77, 79. Golden test recommendation is the right guard; when introducing stable_key, emit the same bytes as today for existing actions or accept a one-time migration.
